prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a strong first call for individual or family coverage in the Kansas City area. It says it compares Marketplace and private plans, serves both sides of the state line, and has a 5.0 Google rating listed with 90 reviews. Call **(816) 205-4664** or visit [bbs-insurance.com](https://bbs-insurance.com/health-insurance/).

If you’re in **Overland Park or elsewhere on the Kansas side**, **AIS Health Insurance Advisors** is another option; it says it helps with ACA Marketplace plans and subsidies and offers no-cost advice. Call **913-333-8627** or visit [aishealthadvisors.com](https://aishealthadvisors.com/).

Before choosing, ask the broker to check your doctors, prescriptions, expected care, and subsidy eligibility—and confirm they compare multiple insurers. Broker services are often free to you, but brokers may receive commissions from insurers. If you mean **Medicare** rather than under-65 coverage, say so: the best fit may be different.
